Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building ages, sizes, classrooms, specialized spaces, and detailed site maps (Sections 4, pages 27-110). Robust condition assessments cover HVAC, roofing, electrical, plumbing, ADA compliance, and more, with detailed cost estimates and connection to long-term capital planning (pages 103-110).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections over 10+ years using weighted cohort trend analysis, birth rates, housing development, and demographic data (Section 3, pages 21-30). Capacity utilization data by site and classroom with net classroom counts and detailed analysis of under- and over-capacity schools, linked to specific facility actions and new construction projects (pages 27-60).

Educational Alignment.justification: Plan includes educational mission and goals and relates them to facilities, with references to CTE classrooms, science labs, and program-specific spaces (e.g., food science lab, welding shop) (pages 31-110). However, integration between educational goals and facility projects is present but not fully comprehensive or explicitly framed as a core organizing principle.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: References to outdoor spaces such as athletic fields, playgrounds, and shade structures are present (e.g., metal shade structures, soccer fields), but limited data or districtwide analysis of green space, canopy cover, or greening strategies (pages 33, 79, 107). Outdoor learning and environmental literacy are not explicitly addressed.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Minimal mention of climate risks or resilience strategies. No comprehensive climate risk assessment or detailed mitigation strategies related to climate impacts are evident in the provided content.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions some energy efficiency projects such as HVAC upgrades and replacement of systems, but lacks comprehensive data on energy use or detailed strategies for energy resilience, electrification, or decarbonization. No explicit reference to state requirements like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Detailed financial plan including multiple funding sources (state modernization, new construction, developer fees, bonds, COPs), cost estimates with escalation and contingencies, and prioritization framework (pages 4-17). Comprehensive capital strategy aligns funding with district priorities and includes long-term sustainability considerations.
